name: @nexus/mcp-codex-delegate
description: MCP server that exposes a single `delegate_to_codex` tool to Claude Code sessions. Wraps the codex-gateway HTTP async-job protocol (POST /api/jobs + poll GET /api/jobs/:id) so platform-copilot / business-copilot can hand off execution-heavy work (sysadmin, container debugging, fresh-UI research) to GPT-5.5 on KVM2 and surface the full transcript inline in chat. Phase 2c of task_plan-chat.md.
